notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41843745/569acfc03ceed0a296e518146e803a82b54307df.png[/img]Hello friends!

We're back with another update to the Soul Riders Demo!

As per some feedback we have received on the demo, we have taken action to address some of the issues plaguing our CPU players.

CPU players should now race more competently in the Drag Race and Perilous Path minigames. 
Do note, that we are far from finished working on the CPU player's AI and we will continue to update the demo as these fixes are implemented.

Additionally, you may have noticed some subtle changes to some of the sound effects and some of the visual polish in other areas of the game. These are just the beginning to implementing many of our finalized assets into the game.

Lastly, we have fixed a handful of bugs that were discovered both in our own internal testing, as well as bugs that were brought to our attention by our lovely players :)

We at Room 322 Games can't wait to share more and we greatly appreciate all who take the time to check us out! 

As always, feel free to join our discord server to connect with the dev team, give feedback and help us build a community for our game.

[b]Discord Server:[/b] https://discord.gg/vG8eEfuEzh

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Demo Patch #1[/b][/h3]

In this patch, we have tried to address some of the feedback we received since the launch of the demo.
The most notable changes/additions are as follows:

- Added a "Steam Remote Play Together" tutorial to the main menu to help players more easily connect with their friends to play together!

- Added the option to "Play With Bots" to toggle CPU players. 
This option is selected when setting up a normal game of Midnight Mischief. When 'on', CPU players will fill any empty slots (up to 4 players total).

- Streamlined Tutorial. 
Now players should find the tutorial significantly less tedious with a condensed tutorial, walls of text have been replaced with GIFs illustrating the game's controls/mechanics. Overall time to complete the tutorial is also much shorter.

- More Speed Orbs!
Due to the positive feedback surrounding our "Speed Orbs" we have increased the number of them present in the game. They have also undergone a slight rework; now when a player runs through one, it temporarily becomes supercharged and gives a larger speed boost to any players who run through it during this time. This supercharged state is indicated by the orbs turning green. 

- General Bug Fixes

- Clockwork Carrier (The Gear Board) has had it's defense stat reduced very slightly and it's speed stat increased slightly. 
We found that sometimes the Clockwork Carrier would be pseudo-immortal given enough defense stat boosts were collected. We also found that the board was a bit too slow so we made it faster

- Time Warning Added
Now in time based areas of gameplay (roaming maps and Perilous Path), the player will receive a warning at 15 seconds remaining. This is due to some feedback we received about parts of the game ending too abruptly.

Thank you to everyone who provided feedback!

If you have some feedback you'd like to share or just want to connect with our community, join the official Soul Riders Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/vG8eEfuEzh]HERE[/url]

Look forward to more updates to the demo and follow Room 322 Games on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/room322games.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/room322games/]Instagram[/url] for more Soul Riders content :)

notes.title: The Demo Is Here!!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your patience!

The day is finally upon us that we can give you all your first taste of Soul Riders :)

This demo includes a small snippet of the full game, including:
- 1 map
- 4 minigames
- 4 playable characters
- 4 vehicles

And more!

With this, we are also pleased to announce that Soul Riders will be releasing into Steam early access this summer!

Keep an eye for more updates and announcements to come!
